contexts.text: In the middle of the orchestra there was a pulpit...
What is more frequently preached from the pulpits?
A priest... ascended the pulpit... and began a discourse on the Divine Trinity.
In the building of a temple... a pulpit is erected.
I saw a low pulpit, in which stood one who filled the office of president.
Within (the magnificent temple), on the south side towards the west, was a pulpit, on which at the right lay the open Word... the resplendence from which illuminated the whole pulpit.
The pulpit signified the priesthood and preaching (of the New Church). The Word open upon the pulpit and illuminating its upper part, signified the internal sense of the Word revealed...
Some of them can... pour forth from the pulpits many holy things...
These from their chairs, those from their pulpits...
So they sound forth from their pulpits.
